selection_procedure: One manual fixed ordering using only the six listed development/background documents and development-only messages reproduced in the canonical development packet. First use the established accepted packing-3 repair; then the newly qualified immediate-data repair; then packing-2, supported by a previous raw compiler fit rejected only by the original metadata-sensitive schema gate. Packing-2 and packing-4 had equivalent reported old outcomes; choose the lower numeric factor as a deterministic tie-break. No new packing or priority rescue supports replacing these slots. No candidate sweep, score fitting, case-ID lookup, feature conditions, new held-out data, model calls, or compilation was used by the designer.
application: Use this same order for every case. Each candidate replaces the original baseline; edits never accumulate. The runner stops on accepted fit and otherwise permits at most three repair attempts.
